videos.headline: Travis Hunter dives for a Colorado INT
videos.description: UCLA QB Ethan Garbers tries to throw a short pass but is picked off by a diving Travis Hunter for Colorado.

tracking.trackingName: NCF_One-Play (Travis Hunter dives for a Colorado INT) 2023/10/28 ESHEET

videos.headline: Ethan Garbers finds Carson Steele for a UCLA TD
videos.description: UCLA QB Ethan Garbers takes the snap and quickly finds Carson Steele for a touchdown.

tracking.trackingName: NCF_One-Play (Ethan Garbers finds Carson Steele for a UCLA TD) 2023/10/28 ESHEET

videos.headline: Colorado comes up with their second takeaway of the game
videos.description: UCLA RB Carson Steele takes a bit hit, loses the football and Colorado's defense comes up with the recovery.

tracking.trackingName: NCF_One-Play (Colorado comes up with their second takeaway of the game) 202310/28 ESHEET

videos.headline: Travis Hunter comes away with his second INT of the game
videos.description: Colorado's Travis Hunter comes up huge with another interception off of UCLA's Ethan Garbers.

tracking.trackingName: NCF_One-Play (Travis Hunter comes away with his second INT of the game) 2023/10/28 ESHEET

videos.headline: Shilo Sanders ejected for targeting
videos.description: Colorado's Shilo Sanders delivers a big hit on UCLA's Carsen Ryan and gets ejected for targeting.

tracking.trackingName: NCF_One-Play (Shilo Sanders ejected for targeting) 2023/10/28 ESHEET

videos.headline: RJ Lopez doinks a short FG for UCLA
videos.description: UCLA kicker RJ Lopez tries to kick a short field goal late in the second quarter, but he hits it off the left upright.

tracking.trackingName: NCF_One-Play (RJ Lopez doinks a short FG for UCLA) 2023/10/28 ESHEET

videos.headline: UCLA's Carson Steele fumbles the ball away again
videos.description: UCLA RB Carson Steele rushes up the middle, gets hit hard and loses the football as Colorado recovers late in the second quarter.

tracking.trackingName: NCF_One-Play (UCLA's Carson Steele fumbles the ball away again) 2023/10/28 ESHEET

videos.headline: Logan Loya makes incredible toe-tapping grab on the sideline
videos.description: UCLA QB Ethan Garbers tosses to Logan Loya near the sideline, who catches the ball and just taps his foot down inbounds before his other foot touches out of bounds.

tracking.trackingName: NCF_One-Play (Logan Loya makes incredible toe-tapping grab on the sideline) 2023/10/28 ESHEET

videos.headline: TJ Harden's TD run extends UCLA's lead in the 4th
videos.description: UCLA RB TJ Harden gets the handoff and crosses the goal line to widen the Bruins' lead in the fourth quarter.

videos.headline: Collin Schlee keeps it himself to pad UCLA's lead
videos.description: UCLA QB Collin Schlee runs the ball himself and maneuvers his way into the end zone for a touchdown.

videos.headline: Shedeur Sanders finds Jimmy Horn Jr. for a Colorado TD
